```plato

    // The classic smoothstep shaping function 3x^2 - 2x^3, with zero slope at
    // both ends of the unit interval. Assumes x is in [0, 1]; saturate first if not.
    // (For interpolation between two values use SmoothLerp above.)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smoothstep)
    SmoothStep(x: Number): Number
        => x * x * (3.0 - 2.0 * x);
```
